info.title: Shortlist API
info.description: Generated from @shortlist/contracts. Planned endpoints are specified in api-contracts.md until implemented.

get.summary: Readiness to admit redirect traffic (PostgreSQL reachable)
CSRF token for this browser; creates an anonymous session cookie (__Host-session) if needed

200.description: Send this value as X-CSRF-Token on every state-changing request.

post.summary: Create an email/password account and send a verification email. Requires X-CSRF-Token from GET /api/v1/auth/csrf and an allowed Origin.

202.description: Always the same answer, whether or not the email already has an account.

post.summary: Consume an email verification token. Does not sign in. Requires X-CSRF-Token from GET /api/v1/auth/csrf and an allowed Origin.
Send a new verification link (revokes the previous one). Requires X-CSRF-Token from GET /api/v1/auth/csrf and an allowed Origin.

202.description: Always the same answer; mail is sent only to an existing unverified account.

post.summary: Email a password-reset link (revokes earlier links). Requires X-CSRF-Token from GET /api/v1/auth/csrf and an allowed Origin.

202.description: Always the same answer; mail goes only to an existing active account with a password.

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset token. Signs out every existing session; does not sign in. Requires X-CSRF-Token from GET /api/v1/auth/csrf and an allowed Origin.

204.description: Password changed and all previous sessions revoked.

400.description: TOKEN_INVALID, TOKEN_EXPIRED, TOKEN_USED, or VALIDATION_FAILED (newPassword needs 12-256 characters).

post.summary: Sign in with email and password. Replaces the session cookie and CSRF token. Requires X-CSRF-Token from GET /api/v1/auth/csrf and an allowed Origin.

200.description: Signed in. Use the returned csrfToken from now on.

401.description: INVALID_CREDENTIALS, identical for unknown email and wrong password.

post.summary: Start a five-minute Google attempt bound to this browser session; pass the nonce to Google Identity Services. Only when GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is configured. Requires X-CSRF-Token from GET /api/v1/auth/csrf and an allowed Origin.

401.description: link and reauthenticate need a signed-in user.

post.summary: Sign in with the Google ID token (credential) from a login attempt. Replaces the session cookie and CSRF token. Requires X-CSRF-Token from GET /api/v1/auth/csrf and an allowed Origin.

200.description: Signed in (new account created on first use).

401.description: GOOGLE_SIGN_IN_FAILED: unknown, expired, reused or foreign attempt; invalid, expired or foreign token; nonce mismatch.

409.description: ACCOUNT_LINK_REQUIRED: a password account already uses this email; sign in to it and link Google.

503.description: Google's signing keys or session storage unavailable.

200.description: Current user, re-checked against the database.

post.summary: End the session (requires X-CSRF-Token and an allowed Origin)

204.description: Server session deleted and cookie cleared.

403.description: Missing or wrong CSRF token, or foreign Origin.

503.description: Session storage unavailable; the session was not deleted.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Account holders only (ignored for guests): 1-255 visible ASCII characters, e.g. a UUID. The same key and request within 24 hours returns the original 201 with Idempotent-Replayed: true.

post.summary: Create a link. Anonymous (guest) session: generated code, 7-day expiry, body GuestCreateLinkRequest, no management handle. Signed-in verified account: body RegisteredCreateLinkRequest (optional alias and expiry), full Link with Location and ETag. Requires X-CSRF-Token from GET /api/v1/auth/csrf and an allowed Origin.

201.description: Created. Guests receive GuestCreateLinkResponse only; account holders receive Link with Location /api/v1/links/{id} and ETag "v1".

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED (fields listed; unknown fields rejected; expiry must be in the future), INVALID_JSON.

403.description: CSRF_INVALID, ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED, CHALLENGE_REQUIRED (guests; retry with challengeToken), EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED or ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED.

409.description: ALIAS_UNAVAILABLE (taken or reserved; same answer), or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (same key, different request).

503.description: Redis or PostgreSQL unavailable; Retry-After is set.

get.summary: The signed-in owner's links, newest first. Query: cursor (opaque, from nextCursor), limit (1-100, default 20).

200.description: One page; nextCursor is null on the last page.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: limit out of range, or a cursor that was edited or issued to another account.

get.summary: One owned link. Its version is returned as ETag "vN".

404.description: Not found, or not yours (the same answer).

patch.summary: Change destination, expiry (null removes it) or enabled. Requires If-Match: "vN" from the last read. Enabling never overrides an admin block, an expiry or a suspension. Requires X-CSRF-Token from GET /api/v1/auth/csrf and an allowed Origin.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: unknown or immutable fields (code, alias, owner), empty change, past expiry, invalid destination.

412.description: PRECONDITION_FAILED: the link changed since that version; reload and retry.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: UTC date, inclusive. Default: 29 days before today.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: UTC date, exclusive. Default: tomorrow. At most 90 days after from.

get.summary: Owner analytics: lifetime and range totals, zero-filled daily counts, country/device/referrer breakdowns (each adds up to rangeClicks; top 20 referrers plus "other"). Counters are decimal strings; counts are approximate.

200.description: Analytics for the range, read from one consistent snapshot.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: bad date, from not before to, more than 90 days, or older than aggregate retention.

404.description: Not found, not yours, or a guest link.

get.summary: Public redirect (HEAD behaves the same with no body)

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Exact, case-sensitive short code (4-32 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -).

302.description: Active link. Location is the stored destination; the request query is not appended.

405.description: Only GET and HEAD are allowed.

410.description: Inactive link (expired, disabled, blocked or owner suspended).

503.description: Database unavailable or overloaded. Retry-After is set.
